status: Volumetric study. All component envelopes require physical measurement.

confirmed_inventory.user_confirmation: 2026-10-20: current hardware has ESP32-S3 only, no GPIO Extension Board.

display.note: Complete 4-inch module including PCB and rear protrusions; not derived from legacy 3.5-inch STL.

bezel.note: Concept bounding envelope; no fasteners or glass supports designed.

active_screen.note: Nominal 4-inch diagonal with 480:320 aspect; not a measured aperture.

keycap.note: Same 12 physical buttons, 18 mm center pitch.

button_body.note: Below the mounting plane; add separate 5 mm solder envelope.

joystick.note: Board plus mechanism below cap; thumb-motion envelope also included.

esp32.note: Populated DevKit envelope, including headers; no expansion carrier.

battery_holder.note: Complete existing two-cell holder with cells, terminals and tabs. Must measure.

cell.note: 18650 nominal only. Protected cells can be larger; complete holder governs packing.

buck.note: LM2596S including voltmeter, terminals and inductor. Requires side/rear inspection access.

speaker.note: Rectangular drivers seen in rev09 photos; mounting ears included provisionally. Measure first.

amplifier.note: MAX98357A populated module; terminals/wires require confirmation.

led_board.note: Each existing 2x2 NeoPixel board. Preserve both.

switch.note: SW-CELDAS and SW-PANTALLA including terminal envelope.

bulk_cap.note: Two conservative reserves from wiring guide; presence and actual size pending.
